title: The Mainframe Product must protect nonlocal maintenance sessions by separating the maintenance session from other network sessions with the system by logically separated communications paths.
check_content:
Verify the Mainframe Product is configured to protect nonlocal maintenance sessions by separating the maintenance session from other network sessions with the system by logically separated communications paths.

If the Mainframe Product is not configured to protect nonlocal maintenance sessions by separating the maintenance session from other network sessions with the system by logically separated communications paths, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the Mainframe Product to protect nonlocal maintenance sessions by separating the maintenance session from other network sessions with the system by logically separated communications paths.
VulnDiscussion: Nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic activities are conducted by individuals who communicate through either an external or internal network. Communications paths can be logically separated using encryption.
